{{recipe}}

'''Tortilla chips''' cost way more than tortillas, but when they get home, they end up looking like Earth after Mars hits it.

== Ingredients ==
* 10 corn [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]], each cut into 10 wedges
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce|chipotle-based hot sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep-frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine hot sauce, salt, and lime juice in a large dish. Add tortillas and soak for 2 hours.
#Remove to a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
#Deep fry at 375°F until pieces float and are lightly browned around edges. Drain on a cooling rack set above a baking pan. Serve.
